commit.message:
feat(kernel): STEP import through solidcore-step behind the seam, benched against truck

M12.1 stage 4, bench only: crates/app still imports STEP through
truck-stepio; no other workspace crate gains a dependency.

- Pin: crates/kernel takes solidcore, solidcore-step and solidcore-convert
  from the owner's fork at rev 55d0e7638b9e1ebbf91ab8c10657e595c114ecda
  (tag camcraft-pin-2026-11-11) in place of crates.io solidcore =1.0.1;
  solidcore-tess at the same rev is a dev-dependency for the mesh bench.
  Cargo.lock: five git packages replace the one registry package.
- Against 1.0.1 (2973 commits): Brep is no longer Clone (two test helpers
  copy or measure in place); the port now refuses a NaN offset and the
  native reader refuses blank, foreign, noise and header-only files
  itself - five pinned port verdicts re-triaged, all former findings.
- solidcore_step: read_step / import_step - bytes to solids in mm, the
  file's length units and diagnostics; 64 MiB size bound; the caller's
  CancelToken as the time bound (KernelError::TimedOut); panics caught;
  the stage-3 laws (integrity, closed solid, vertex gap) unchanged; an
  unconvertible length unit and a partly read file are refused by name.
- Bench: every STEP fixture through both importers, verdicts pinned.
  Four files agree, three hold no solid and both refuse, and the two
  Milling-test files disagree on the bounding box (the port's tight box
  takes the whole cylinder of a trimmed face - #939). A 19-file corrupt
  corpus through both, under a bound that cancels the import.
- Mesh: solidcore-tess at the app's 0.005 mm chord is watertight and
  closer to the exact volume than truck's mesh on every fixture; what a
  machining mesh still owes is #940.

Decisions in docs/decisions/916-solidcore-step-bench.md; notices in
assets/ui/LICENSES.md.

Fixes #916
